verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents splitting incoming payments into Subaccounts, which is the core marketplace split primitive. It also documents bulk transfers to multiple recipients, which can serve as a payout path to sellers. The evidence is only one-line doc summaries, and nothing describes onboarding sellers or settling payouts automatically to each subaccount. Missing for 10: seller onboarding/KYC flow, explicit per-seller payout or settlement documentation, depth beyond summary lines, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller

citations.quote: Learn how to split incoming payments into Subaccounts.
